constraint_text: The desert_feature_locator must be executed before any call to geographical_proximity_finder; geographical_proximity_finder must be executed before scientific_discovery_finder; scientific_discovery_finder must be executed before research_location_finder; research_location_finder must be executed before geographical_area_calculator; geographical_area_calculator must be executed before landmark_country_skyscraper_finder; landmark_country_skyscraper_finder must be executed before building_info_retriever; and building_info_retriever must be executed before advanced_calculator. Each of desert_feature_locator, geographical_proximity_finder, scientific_discovery_finder, research_location_finder, geographical_area_calculator, landmark_country_skyscraper_finder, building_info_retriever, and advanced_calculator may be used at most once during the solution. The calls to geographical_area_calculator and landmark_country_skyscraper_finder must be issued together in the same step.
